ENGLISH ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #10
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. where is the library
   B. Where is the Library
   C. Where is the library
   D. Where is the library?

2. When practising Word reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Word reading.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word reading.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Word reading.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Word reading.

3. When practising Pronunciation and Vocabulary, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pronunciation and Vocabulary.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Pronunciation and Vocabulary.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Pronunciation and Vocabulary.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Pronunciation and Vocabulary.

4. When practising Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Comprehension.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Comprehension.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Comprehension.

5. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. Only one word repeated
   B. No full stops
   C. Many unrelated topics with no link
   D. One main idea with supporting sentences

6. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only a describing word
   B. A person, place, thing, or idea
   C. Only an action
   D. Only a joining word

7. When practising Pre-reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Pre-reading.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Pre-reading.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Pre-reading.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre-reading.

8. When practising Attentive listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Attentive listening.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive listening.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Attentive listening.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive listening.

9. When practising Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Handwriting.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Handwriting.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Handwriting.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Handwriting.

10. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. happiness
   B. quickly
   C. blue
   D. run

11. When practising Language structures School, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Language structures School.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language structures School.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Language structures School.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Language structures School.

12. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. goes
   B. went
   C. going
   D. goed

13. When practising Pre- Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre- Writing.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Pre- Writing.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Pre- Writing.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Pre- Writing.

14. When practising Letter sound knowledge, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Letter sound knowledge.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Letter sound knowledge.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Letter sound knowledge.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Letter sound knowledge.

15. When practising Connected text reading and fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Connected text reading and fluency.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Connected text reading and fluency.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Connected text reading and fluency.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Connected text reading and fluency.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Connected text reading and fluency and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Pre- Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Handwriting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Spelling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Punctuation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Attentive listening and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Pronunciation and Vocabulary and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Language structures School and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
